question: Which of the following channels is NOT a part of six communication mail channels to facilitate quick delivery of mails in large towns and cities of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Weekly channel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian Postal Department has introduced multiple channels to ensure quick delivery of mails in urban areas.
 
• The key channels include the **Periodical channel, Business channel, and Metro channel**.
 
• The **Weekly channel** is not part of the established six communication mail channels.
 
• These channels aim to streamline and expedite the sorting and delivery process of mail in large towns and cities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periodical Channel:**

 
 
• Used for handling periodicals and magazines.
 
• Ensures timely delivery of subscribed publications to readers.
 
 
 
• **Business Channel:**
 
 
• Catered to bulk mail from business enterprises.
 
• Includes business correspondence, invoices, and promotional material.
 
 
 
• **Metro Channel:**
 
 
• Specialized for mail in metropolitan areas.
 
• Designed to handle high mail volumes in large cities efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Express Channel:**
 
 
• Provides expedited delivery services for urgent mail.
 
• Commonly used for express parcels and important documents.
